column1: # linux-disk-usage usual-suspects catalog. Tab-separated; consumed by scan-suspects.sh.
# Columns: kind(path|dir)  id  target  marker  tier(safe|decision|userdata)  command  regen  note
#   path: literal path (relative to --home-dir unless absolute); du'd if it exists.
#   dir : basename found under --root (find -name, so a glob works), or a path suffix when it contains /
#         (e.g. .claude/worktrees); counted only if <marker> exists in its parent - the dir holding the
#         whole suffix (- = no marker). A glob target cannot use a marker or {parent}: both strip the
#   command placeholders: {dir} = matched path, {parent} = the dir holding the matched basename or suffix.
# Patterns only - never machine-specific paths (this repo is public).
